test_title: PYST 167: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held On - 09 Feb, 2023 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question:
In a certain code language,

‘A + B’ means ‘A is the brother of B’,

‘A – B’ means ‘A is the mother of B’,

‘A × B’ means ‘A is the son of B’ and

‘A ÷ B’ means ‘A is the sister of B’.

If C + D – L ÷ P × Q × V, then which of the following statements is NOT correct?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 +
 -
 ×
 ÷
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Mother
 Son
 Sister
 
 

 

Given: C + D – L ÷ P × Q × V

It means: C is the Brother of D, D is the Mother of L, L is the Sister of P, P is the Son of Q, Q is the Son of V.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e88b56d2d66dd46e29b04b23ccba0b93d2eb0aef3ab228170e8d2a78116e15b.png] 

Option 1: C is P’s father’s brother - **False **(C is P's mother Brother).

Option 2: L is Q’s daughter - True

Option 3: D is V’s son’s wife - True

Option 4: D is P’s mother - True

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".
